title: Astronauts Return After Seven Months in Space
paragraphs: Four astronauts are back on Earth. They lived on the International Space Station. They were in space for 237 days.
On 8 October 2026, their spaceship came down in the sea. It landed near Los Angeles, in the USA. Boats took the astronauts home.
In space, they did many tests for science. Two of them went outside the station. Sophie Adenot from France went outside three times.

questions.a: In the sea near Los Angeles.
